verdict.rationale: Several evidence items come from the public GitHub repository github.com/supabase/auth, which suggests the Auth server's source is publicly readable. However, no item states the license or confirms the repo is the full product source. A community comment praising Supabase's 'openness' is vague and does not establish licensing. Missing for 10: explicit open-source license identification, confirmation that the repo is the complete product source, and independent corroboration of self-hostable open code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
